mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN s.kind = 'TASK' THEN s.owner_id ELSE NULL END AS task_id, b.binding_id, COALESCE(t.status, r.status) AS task_status, (COALESCE(t.cancel_requested_at, r.cancel_requested_at) IS NOT NULL) AS cancellation_requested, b.scope_id FROM sq_runtime_binding b JOIN sq_execution_scope s ON s.user_id = b.user_id AND s.scope_id = b.scope_id LEFT JOIN sq_goal_task t ON s.kind = 'TASK' AND t.user_id = s.user_id AND t.task_id = s.owner_id LEFT JOIN sq_response_execution r ON s.kind = 'RESPONSE' AND r.user_id = s.user_id AND r.execution_id = s.owner_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.framework_session_id = #{sessionId} AND b.role = 'MASTER' AND b.del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_operation (operation_id, user_id, task_id, job_id, binding_id, framework_turn_id, tool_call_id, tool_key, tool_version, business_intent_key, effect, connection_id, connection_revision, auth_version, request_hash, arguments_json, status, version, scope_id, budget_usage_key, creator_id, creator_name, last_updater_id, last_updater_name) VALUES (#{operationId}, #{userId}, #{taskId}, #{jobId}, #{bindingId}, #{frameworkTurnId}, #{toolCallId}, #{toolKey}, #{toolVersion}, #{businessIntentKey}, #{effect}, #{connectionId}, #{connectionRevision}, #{authVersion}, #{requestHash}, #{argumentsJson}, #{status}, 0, (SELECT scope_id FROM sq_runtime_binding WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId}), #{budgetUsageKey}, #{userId}, #{creatorName}, #{userId}, #{creatorName})
mapper.select: SELECT operation_id, user_id, task_id, job_id, binding_id, framework_turn_id, tool_call_id, tool_key, tool_version, business_intent_key, effect, connection_id, connection_revision, auth_version, request_hash, arguments_json, status, version, executor_owner, executor_fence, external_key, result_json, scope_id, budget_usage_key FROM sq_operation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND framework_turn_id = #{frameworkTurnId} AND tool_call_id = #{toolCallId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT operation_id, user_id, task_id, job_id, binding_id, framework_turn_id, tool_call_id, tool_key, tool_version, business_intent_key, effect, connection_id, connection_revision, auth_version, request_hash, arguments_json, status, version, executor_owner, executor_fence, external_key, result_json, scope_id, budget_usage_key FROM sq_operation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} AND tool_key = #{toolKey} AND business_intent_key = #{businessIntentKey} FOR UPDATE

SELECT operation_id, user_id, task_id, job_id, binding_id, framework_turn_id, tool_call_id, tool_key, tool_version, business_intent_key, effect, connection_id, connection_revision, auth_version, request_hash, arguments_json, status, version, executor_owner, executor_fence, external_key, result_json, scope_id, budget_usage_key FROM sq_operation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND operation_id = #{operationId}

SELECT operation_id, user_id, task_id, job_id, binding_id, framework_turn_id, tool_call_id, tool_key, tool_version, business_intent_key, effect, connection_id, connection_revision, auth_version, request_hash, arguments_json, status, version, executor_owner, executor_fence, external_key, result_json, scope_id, budget_usage_key FROM sq_operation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND del_flag = '0' AND id < #{cursorId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT id FROM sq_operation WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND operation_id = #{operationId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_operation SET status = 'IN_FLIGHT', executor_owner = #{owner}, executor_fence = #{fence}, executor_until = #{leaseUntil}, external_key = #{externalKey}, version = version + 1, last_updater_id = #{owner} WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND operation_id = #{operationId} AND status IN ('PREPARED', 'WAITING_APPROVAL') AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_execution_scope s JOIN sq_conversation c ON c.user_id = s.user_id AND c.conversation_id = s.conversation_id WHERE s.user_id = sq_operation.user_id AND s.scope_id = sq_operation.scope_id AND s.del_flag = '0' AND c.del_flag = '0' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.generation = s.conversation_generation AND ((s.kind = 'TASK' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_goal_task t WHERE t.user_id = s.user_id AND t.task_id = s.owner_id AND t.scope_id = s.scope_id AND t.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND t.del_flag = '0' AND t.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_APPROVAL', 'WAITING_INPUT', 'WAITING_WORKERS'))) OR (s.kind = 'RESPONSE' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sq_response_execution r WHERE r.user_id = s.user_id AND r.execution_id = s.owner_id AND r.scope_id = s.scope_id AND r.cancel_requested_at IS NULL AND r.del_flag = '0' AND r.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING', 'WAITING_APPROVAL', 'WAITING_INPUT')))))
mapper.select: SELECT operation_id, user_id, task_id, job_id, binding_id, framework_turn_id, tool_call_id, tool_key, tool_version, business_intent_key, effect, connection_id, connection_revision, auth_version, request_hash, arguments_json, status, version, executor_owner, executor_fence, external_key, result_json, scope_id, budget_usage_key FROM sq_operation WHERE status = 'IN_FLIGHT' AND executor_until < #{now} AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT o.operation_id FROM sq_operation o JOIN sq_execution_scope s ON s.user_id = o.user_id AND s.scope_id = o.scope_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status IN ('UNKNOWN', 'RECONCILING') AND o.del_flag = '0' AND s.conversation_id = (SELECT conversation_id FROM sq_execution_scope WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId}) FOR UPDATE
